Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on land use change projections in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP), which is a regional/transboundary area covering parts of six Chinese provinces but not the entire country. It fails the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation (entire country)" as the study area is explicitly defined as the QTP (~2.57 million km², ~1/4 of China’s land area). Although it uses multiple SSP scenarios, performs quantitative future LULC projections, and includes mapped outputs, its regional scope triggers exclusion under the specific exclusion criterion: “Local/regional/global/transboundary scale focus.” The paper does not disaggregate results to or cover all of China, thus not meeting national-scale requirements.)
